ANWIK Research Labs is a global R&D and manufacturing company specializing in pharmacopeia-grade primary reference standards. Production is carried out at our ISO-accredited and GMP-compliant facilities.

Our portfolio of 350,000+ high-tech materials includes:
- Reference standards & impurities (incl. controlled)
- Deuterated compounds & stable isotopes
- Reagents, nitrosamines & pesticides
- Trace metal standards and many more.

Anwik Research Labs is advancing several high-value technology platforms that address the evolving needs of the global pharmaceutical industry. The company specializes in the development and commercial-scale manufacturing of deuterated building blocks, reagents, intermediates, and active pharmaceutical ingredients, while also providing custom development services for deuterated molecules across research and commercial programs.

One of the company’s key innovation areas is the development of stable isotope-based solutions, spanning the entire value chain from isotope raw materials to the synthesis of isotope-labeled reference standards, impurities, metabolites, and APIs used in pharmaceutical research, bioanalytical studies, and drug development.

Anwik Research Labs also offers a comprehensive portfolio of reference materials for elemental impurity testing and trace metal analysis, supporting laboratories in meeting the requirements of ICH Q3D and major pharmacopoeial standards through advanced analytical techniques, including ICP-MS, ICP-OES, and AAS.

By combining expertise in isotope chemistry, analytical reference standards, and pharmaceutical development, Anwik Research Labs enables pharmaceutical manufacturers, CROs, and analytical laboratories to accelerate research, strengthen analytical reliability, and maintain compliance with global regulatory expectations.
